title: Solstice oncall scratchlist
content:
Context: quick personal scratchpad for tonight's solo coverage. Not a canonical runbook, use as temporary checklist and hotfix snippets.

Topline summary:
- System steady at start-of-shift: 99.94% p99 API success, latency baseline 120ms.
- Open tickets: INF-742 (sporadic TTL cache thrashing), INF-759 (small queue backlog in eu-west-1 at 02:10 UTC).
- Model fallback engaged earlier today for a small spike; no customer impact recorded.

Immediate watchouts (first hour):
- Watch for cache TTL spikes around 04:00 UTC (expected traffic sweep).
- If p50 > 300ms for 10m, flip traffic to light-tier model routing (see quick rollback).

Quick escalation contacts (order):
1) Pager: Eli Navarro (SRE lead)
2) Slack alert channel: #infra-pagers
3) On-call engineer: Priya Kapoor (backup)
4) If hardware suspected: platform-eng oncall

Short procedures (scratchy steps, validate before full run):
A) Restart inference pool worker (graceful)
- check pool status: curl -sS http://infra-api/internal/pools | jq '.pools[] | select(.name=="xr-pool")'
- cordon node: kubectl cordon gpu-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
- scale down replica: kubectl scale deploy/xr-runtime -n inference --replicas=3
- watch logs: kubectl logs -f deploy/xr-runtime -n inference --tail=200
- scale up after healthy: kubectl scale deploy/xr-runtime -n inference --replicas=5
Notes: draining often clears KV cache lockups; expect transient 5-15s increased latency.

B) Quick model fallback (traffic steering)
- Playground: change route policy in routing-config (temp override) to use model-variant: gpt-legacy-8q
- CLI: infractl route set --route default --model gpt-legacy-8q --weight 100
- Monitor: token-per-second metric and error-rate. Revert after stability.

C) Memory OOM on runtime pod
- Describe pod: kubectl describe pod <pod> -n inference
- Dump last oom: kubectl logs <pod> --previous -n inference | tail -n 200
- If repeated: redeploy with smaller batch_size env var: BATCH_SIZE=1 (temp)

Handoff checklist (what I will pass on):
- Active tickets + last action: INF-742: added cache metrics, triggered graceful drain at 01:45 UTC.
- Configuration changes: increased instance protection on dedicated nodes at 01:00 UTC. Undo note in INF-742 if it causes backlog.
- Metrics to keep an eye on: p50/p95/p99 latency, queue depth, per-route error-rate, cache hit ratio.

Pending followups (post-shift):
- Convert quick fallback steps into proper rollback play in Confluence (assign to Priya).
- Investigate TTL distribution: add a histogram for prefix lengths (INF-742).
- Profile a batch example that triggered OOM (save trace and upload).

Random notes to self (scratchy):
- Try to get a proper dry-run for infractl routing change (sandbox) before flipping prod next time.
- Add a shorter alarm for cache-thrashing (5m window).
- Keep laptop charged and VPN stable.

If you take over: ping me in slack (@maya) if you want a 5-minute call to orient on the tickets. Otherwise, log any manual steps in INF-742/INF-759 so we can stitch a final runbook.

End of scratchlist.
(Loose/rough: do not treat as authoritative runbook; file a proper PR after incident notes consolidated.)
